HEAD OFFICE MTN WALLET INBALANCE 
A review of the MTN wallet balance noted that the wallet had a balance of GHS113,353,052.00 while the coresponding GL had a balance of GHS115,715,145.44 as at COB September 09, 2026 resulting in an imbalance of GHS2,362,093.44.
In response to a mail the Team Lead (Transaction Processing) stated that at the close of business on September 9, 2026, it was noted that the Airport Branch evacuated GHS 2,362,093.34 on the MTN Portal but subsequently keyed GHS 2,362,093.44 in the GL, resulting in an imbalance of GHS 0.10. The Branch was contacted and advised to reverse the incorrectly keyed amount, as the discrepancy was affecting the bank's position. The required reversal was not actioned hence the discrepancy. This has been rectified.
The team should continue to monitor these GLs to ensure the mobile money balances are consistent with Gl balances.

ABSENCE OF APPROVAL DOCUMENTATION FOR GRANTED CREDIT LIMITS
During a review of Visa Credit Cards issued between April and July 2026, it was observed that although credit limits had been assigned to the underlisted (6) six customers, however there was no evidence of a Credit Card Approval Form which had been signed by the Manager of Credit Evaluation, Ag. Head, Credit Manager with authorization/approval granted by the Managing Director. 

In accordance with the Visa Classic Credit Card Issuing SOP (Process ID: CS/CRI/001), when a customer submits a credit card request by completing a credit card application form and all requisite documentation through the Relationship Manager, the team must subsequently receive approval from the Manager of Credit Evaluation, Ag. Head, Credit Manager and authorization/approval granted from the Managing Director before a credit limit can be granted. But this was not done.

1. ADDISON CLAUDIA - 0010150581036 - GHS50,000.00
2. YEBUAH CHARLES OKYERE AGYEBENG - 0010272932028 - GHS120,000.00
3. SAMUEL KWADWO AGYAPONG - 0010223686029 - GHS120,000.00
4. KENNEDY BUABENG-AMPOFO - 0010278270028 - GHS50,000.00
5. ALFRED KOFI GYATENG - 0010224548020 - GHS100,00.00
6. SOKRATIS SOKRATOUS - 0010230306028 - GHS55,000.00

ICDD strongly recommends that the Card Support Unit engage the relevant stakeholders to regularize these breach by obtaining and documenting the requisite approvals for the affected credit card facilities. Also, they should ensure that, going forward, all Visa Credit Card applications are processed strictly in accordance with the Visa Classic Credit Card Issuing SOP (Process ID: CS/CRI/001), with the appropriate approvals from the Managing Director, Head of Credit, and other designated stakeholders secured prior to the assignment of any credit limit.
